name: Jaipur
tagline: The Pink City of palaces and forts
description: Jaipur is the capital of Rajasthan and a cornerstone of the Golden Triangle. Its hilltop forts, royal palaces, bustling bazaars and vivid Rajasthani cuisine make it one of India's most rewarding heritage destinations.

places.name: Amber Fort
places.description: A hilltop fort-palace with mirrored halls and sweeping views over Maota Lake.

places.name: City Palace
places.description: The royal residence blending Rajput and Mughal architecture, with museums and courtyards.

places.name: Hawa Mahal
places.description: The honeycombed 'Palace of Winds' facade, best photographed in the morning light.

places.name: Nahargarh Fort
places.description: A ridge-top fort with sunset views over the whole city.

places.name: Jantar Mantar
places.description: A UNESCO-listed collection of giant 18th-century astronomical instruments.

places.name: Johari Bazaar
places.description: A traditional market famous for jewellery, textiles and block-printed fabrics.

hotels.name: Hotel Pearl Palace
hotels.description: Popular budget guesthouse with a rooftop restaurant and friendly service.

hotels.name: Alsisar Haveli
hotels.description: A restored heritage haveli with courtyards and a pool.

hotels.name: Rambagh Palace
hotels.description: The former Maharaja's residence, now an iconic palace hotel.

restaurants.name: Laxmi Misthan Bhandar (LMB)
restaurants.description: A Johari Bazaar institution for vegetarian food and mithai.

restaurants.name: Chokhi Dhani
restaurants.description: An ethnic village resort with folk performances and a traditional meal.

restaurants.name: Handi Restaurant
restaurants.description: A long-running spot for rich North Indian curries.

restaurants.name: Rawat Mishthan Bhandar
restaurants.description: Famous for flaky kachoris.

name: Goa
description: Goa is India's beach capital, mixing lively sands and nightlife in the north with quiet coves in the south. Old Goa's churches and the fort at Aguada reflect centuries of Portuguese rule, while the seafood is a highlight.

places.name: Baga Beach
places.description: A lively beach with water sports, shacks and nightlife nearby.

places.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
places.description: A UNESCO-listed baroque church in Old Goa.

places.name: Fort Aguada
places.description: A 17th-century Portuguese fort with a lighthouse and sea views.

places.name: Dudhsagar Falls
places.description: A four-tiered waterfall reached by a jeep safari through forest; best after the monsoon.

places.name: Palolem Beach
places.description: A calm crescent beach in South Goa, ideal for unwinding.

places.name: Anjuna Flea Market
places.description: A weekly market for handicrafts, clothes and souvenirs.

hotels.name: Zostel Goa
hotels.description: A social hostel with dorms and private rooms near the beaches.

hotels.name: Taj Fort Aguada Resort & Spa
hotels.description: A clifftop resort overlooking the Arabian Sea.

hotels.name: Alila Diwa Goa
hotels.description: A resort set among paddy fields in South Goa.

restaurants.name: Britto's
restaurants.specialty: Fish curry rice and grilled seafood
restaurants.description: A beachside classic at Baga.

restaurants.name: Fisherman's Wharf
restaurants.description: Riverside dining with Goan seafood.

restaurants.name: Vinayak Family Restaurant
restaurants.description: Home-style Goan food in Assagao.

restaurants.name: Thalassa
restaurants.specialty: Greek mezze with a sunset view
restaurants.description: A Greek taverna on the Vagator cliffs.

name: Kerala
tagline: Backwaters, tea hills and spice trails
description: Kerala, 'God's Own Country', offers palm-fringed backwaters, misty tea plantations in Munnar, wildlife in Periyar and the colonial charm of Fort Kochi. The cuisine is built on coconut, spices and fresh seafood.

places.name: Alleppey Backwaters
places.description: Cruise the canals on a houseboat or shikara past villages and paddy fields.

places.name: Munnar Tea Gardens
places.description: Rolling hills of tea estates, viewpoints and cool weather.

places.name: Fort Kochi
places.description: Chinese fishing nets, Dutch and Portuguese buildings and art cafes.

places.name: Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary
places.description: A reserve around Periyar Lake, known for elephants and boat safaris.

places.name: Kovalam Beach
places.description: A crescent beach near Thiruvananthapuram with a lighthouse.

hotels.name: Fort Kochi Heritage Homestay (generic listing)
hotels.description: Typical homestays in Fort Kochi offer simple rooms and home-cooked Kerala food.

hotels.name: Backwater Houseboat Stay, Alleppey (generic listing)
hotels.description: An overnight houseboat with meals; price varies a lot by season and size.

hotels.name: Taj Malabar Resort & Spa, Kochi
hotels.description: A waterfront luxury hotel on Willingdon Island.

restaurants.name: Kashi Art Cafe
restaurants.description: A gallery cafe in Fort Kochi.

restaurants.name: Dhe Puttu
restaurants.description: A casual restaurant built around puttu.

restaurants.name: Paragon Restaurant
restaurants.description: A well-known Kerala seafood and biryani restaurant.

name: Varanasi
tagline: The spiritual heart of India on the Ganga
description: Varanasi is among the world's oldest living cities and a major pilgrimage site for Hindus. Dawn boat rides, the evening Ganga aarti, narrow lanes of temples and a rich street-food culture define a visit.

places.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
places.description: The main ghat, famous for its grand evening Ganga aarti.

places.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
places.description: One of the most revered Shiva temples; expect queues and security checks.

places.name: Sarnath
places.description: Where the Buddha gave his first sermon; stupas, ruins and a museum.

places.name: Assi Ghat
places.description: A calmer ghat for sunrise, yoga and cafes.

places.name: Ramnagar Fort
places.description: An 18th-century fort across the river, with a small museum.

hotels.name: Zostel Varanasi
hotels.description: A backpacker hostel with a social atmosphere.

hotels.name: Ganges View Hotel
hotels.description: A heritage-style hotel near Assi Ghat.

hotels.name: Brijrama Palace
hotels.description: A restored palace on the ghats.

restaurants.name: Kashi Chat Bhandar
restaurants.description: A legendary chaat shop.

restaurants.name: Blue Lassi
restaurants.description: A tiny shop known for thick lassis.

restaurants.name: Deena Chat Bhandar
restaurants.description: A local favourite for evening snacks.

name: Delhi
description: India's capital layers centuries of history, from the Mughal-era Red Fort and Humayun's Tomb to Lutyens' New Delhi. It is also one of the country's best food cities.

places.name: Red Fort
places.description: The 17th-century Mughal fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

places.name: Qutub Minar
places.description: A soaring 13th-century minaret complex.

places.name: India Gate
places.description: A war memorial arch, lovely in the evening.

places.name: Humayun's Tomb
places.description: A garden tomb that inspired the Taj Mahal's design.

places.name: Lotus Temple
places.description: A lotus-shaped Baha'i House of Worship open to all.

places.name: Chandni Chowk
places.description: Old Delhi's market lanes packed with street food and shops.

hotels.name: Zostel Delhi
hotels.description: A hostel with dorms and private rooms.

hotels.name: The Broadway Hotel
hotels.description: A well-located hotel near Old Delhi.

hotels.name: The Imperial
hotels.description: A heritage luxury hotel in central Delhi.

restaurants.name: Karim's

restaurants.name: Paranthe Wali Gali
restaurants.description: A lane of parantha shops in Chandni Chowk.

restaurants.name: Indian Accent
restaurants.description: A fine-dining restaurant.

restaurants.name: Bukhara
restaurants.description: A famous fine-dining tandoor restaurant.

name: Agra
description: Agra's Mughal heritage includes the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort and the abandoned city of Fatehpur Sikri. A day or two is enough to cover the main sights.

places.name: Taj Mahal
places.description: The marble mausoleum built by Shah Jahan; closed on Fridays, best at sunrise.

places.name: Agra Fort
places.description: A red sandstone fort with palaces and views of the Taj.

places.name: Fatehpur Sikri
places.description: Akbar's abandoned red-sandstone capital, about 40 km from Agra.

places.name: Mehtab Bagh
places.description: A garden across the Yamuna with a sunset view of the Taj.

places.name: Itimad-ud-Daulah
places.description: An ornate tomb often called the 'Baby Taj'.

hotels.name: Zostel Agra
hotels.description: A hostel close to the Taj area.

hotels.name: Hotel Clarks Shiraz
hotels.description: A long-standing mid-range hotel.

hotels.name: The Oberoi Amarvilas
hotels.description: A luxury hotel with Taj views.

restaurants.name: Joney's Place
restaurants.description: A cafe popular with backpackers.

restaurants.name: Pinch of Spice
restaurants.description: A popular family restaurant.

restaurants.name: Mama Chicken Mama Franky House
restaurants.description: A Sadar Bazaar favourite.

name: Manali
description: Manali sits in the Beas valley and is a base for snow, trekking, paragliding and river rafting. Old Manali offers cafes and a relaxed vibe.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June for pleasant weather; December to February for snow

places.name: Solang Valley
places.description: Paragliding, zorbing and skiing depending on the season.

places.name: Rohtang Pass
places.description: A high mountain pass with snow views; a permit is needed and access depends on the season and weather.

places.name: Hadimba Temple
places.description: A wooden temple among deodar trees.

places.name: Old Manali
places.description: Cafes, bridges and riverside walks.

places.name: Jogini Waterfall
places.description: A short trek from Vashisht to a mountain waterfall.

hotels.name: Zostel Manali
hotels.description: A hostel in Old Manali.

hotels.description: A cosy lodge with garden cottages.

hotels.name: Span Resort & Spa

restaurants.name: Cafe 1947
restaurants.description: A popular cafe in Old Manali.

restaurants.name: Chopsticks Restaurant
restaurants.description: A casual spot for Himalayan comfort food.

name: Hyderabad
description: Hyderabad is known for the Charminar, Golconda Fort and Nizam-era palaces, plus a world-famous biryani culture and a modern tech skyline.

places.name: Charminar
places.description: The 16th-century monument at the heart of the old city, beside Laad Bazaar.

places.name: Golconda Fort
places.description: A hilltop fortress known for its acoustics and evening sound-and-light show.

places.name: Chowmahalla Palace
places.description: The Nizams' palace complex with courtyards and a vintage car collection.

places.name: Hussain Sagar Lake
places.description: A large lake with the Buddha statue and a promenade.

places.name: Ramoji Film City
places.description: A huge film studio complex with tours and shows.

places.name: Laad Bazaar

name: Mumbai
description: Mumbai combines colonial architecture, Bollywood, sea-facing promenades and a large street-food scene. Elephanta Caves and Sanjay Gandhi National Park offer a break from the city.

places.name: Gateway of India
places.description: The waterfront arch and starting point for Elephanta boats.

places.name: Marine Drive
places.description: A curved seafront promenade, lovely at sunset.

places.name: Elephanta Caves
places.description: Rock-cut cave temples on an island, reached by ferry.

places.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
places.description: A Victorian Gothic railway station and UNESCO World Heritage Site.

places.name: Sanjay Gandhi National Park
places.description: A forested park within the city, home to the Kanheri Caves.

places.name: Colaba Causeway
places.description: A busy street market for clothes, jewellery and souvenirs.

name: Udaipur
description: Udaipur is known for its palaces reflected in Lake Pichola, romantic rooftop restaurants and Mewar heritage. It is slower and more relaxed than other Rajasthan cities.

places.name: City Palace Udaipur
places.description: A grand palace complex on the lake shore, with museums and views.

places.name: Lake Pichola Boat Ride
places.description: A sunset cruise past the Lake Palace and Jag Mandir.

places.name: Jag Mandir
